systemTitle: ADSE P12 Safety Engineering Truth Capability Register

capabilities.name: P11 Failure Mode to P12 Hazard Derivation
capabilities.description: Formally derives Hazards from P11 Failure Modes, calculating risk level via MIL-STD-882E severity and likelihood matrix.

capabilities.name: Safety Control & Barrier Tracing
capabilities.description: Registers preventive/mitigation safety controls, validates efficiency bounds [0.0, 1.0], and establishes MITIGATES/SATISFIES Digital Thread edges.

capabilities.name: Safety Claim Verification & Traceability
capabilities.description: Registers safety claims linked to hazards and controls, establishing ADDRESSES and SUPPORTED_BY Digital Thread edges.

capabilities.name: Structured Assurance Case (GSN Engine)
capabilities.description: Constructs hierarchical Goal Structuring Notation trees containing goals, strategies, contexts, claims, and evidence references.

capabilities.name: Human Chief Safety Authority Boundary
capabilities.description: Enforces backend rejection of synthetic AI entities and non-authorized roles attempting safety sign-offs or risk overrides.

capabilities.name: Automated Evidence Invalidation Cascade
capabilities.description: Cascades evidence invalidation from P10 measurement changes downstream through safety controls, claims, and cases to REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED.

capabilities.name: Cryptographic Merkle Snapshot Persistence
capabilities.description: Generates SHA-256 Merkle root hashes across safety domain state, enabling rehydration and anti-tamper verification.

capabilities.name: SECP Digital Thread Authority Unification
capabilities.description: Registers all safety nodes and edges in P4 Digital Thread without creating a parallel safety thread or shadow provenance graph.
